title: Trump and Netanyahu to Hamas: accept Gaza peace plan or face consequences
summary: Pair say proposal represents new chapter but Israeli PM threatens to ‘finish the job’ if Hamas officials fail to agree Donald Trump and the Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu have delivered an ultimatum to Hamas, warning the militant group to accept their 20-point peace plan for Gaza or face the consequences. The two leaders met at the White House in Washington on Monday then held a joint press briefing in which they hailed their proposal as a historic breakthrough and new chapter for the Middle East. title: Live Updates: Trump Releases Gaza Plan and Says Hamas Must Accept It
summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he supported the proposal, and Mr. Trump said Israel would have his “full backing” to destroy Hamas if the militant group did not agree to its terms. Hamas said it was not consulted on the plan.
